name: SSL 1 Jönköping 2017

venue.name: [Kulturhuset Jönköping] (http://kulturhusetjonkoping.se/)
venue.details: The room is called Kulturvinden, located in the attic.

information: The competition is a part of the Swedish Speedcubing League 2017. This is the first out of four competitions, followed by a final competiton later this year. The entry fee is set to 100 SEK and must be payed in advance by swedish competitors. Foreigners may pay at the competition venue. A competitor limit has been set to 70 competitors due to venue constraints. More information and payment details can be found on the competition website.
